claim: Mostly-identical unresolved alternatives can share physical state and pure computation without merging epistemic/provenance identity or granting effect authority; PSW must add unique value over conventional sparse overlay plus exact read-signature memoization.

main_matrix.representative_replication: F=1024,N=256,read_set=16 across six seeds and all six divergence levels

baselines.description: materialized independent branch dictionaries; required weak physical baseline
one immutable base plus per-branch override map and exact branch metadata
SPARSE_OVERLAY plus pure-transition cache keyed by exact transition identity/read signature; strongest direct conventional baseline
field-wise branch->value guarded maps with memoized read signatures; proxy for faceted/guarded representation
analytical/prior-art baseline; no claim that the Python overlay benchmark implements a production HAMT/persistent tree

correctness_controls: every branch reconstructed from base+delta equals materialized full-copy branch
FULL_COPY, OVERLAY, OVERLAY_MEMO and PSW pure outputs must exactly match
payload-identical but provenance/hypothesis-distinct branches must not auto-merge
causal_ablations: NO_TRANSITION_LIFT -> force N pure evaluations and compare operation/time scaling
INCOMPLETE_READ_SET -> omit one true material read and demand a concrete false-share counterexample
PAYLOAD_ONLY_MERGE -> demand concrete provenance/hypothesis false-merge counterexample
decision_law: Beating FULL_COPY is insufficient. If SPARSE_OVERLAY_MEMO has identical exact output/operation grouping and lower-or-equivalent metadata/time, PSW has no unique architecture benefit and must not be promoted.
limitations_declared_up_front: JSON wire bytes are serialization proxy, not RSS
controlled integer state fields, not full Clay values
persistent HAMT/BDD production implementations not implemented
pure transition read sets are provided as trusted exact contracts in the positive path
